Findings.Message: File imports 'EPiServer.Find'. The Search & Navigation (Find) API is not available in CMS 13, so the code in this file that uses it must move to Optimizely Graph.
Findings.SuggestedFix: Replace the Find queries, filters and indexing conventions in this file with Optimizely Graph equivalents, then remove the using directive(s).

Findings.Message: Synchronous search execution call '.GetContentResult()' detected. Graph queries in CMS 13 require async execution.
Findings.SuggestedFix: Rewrite the query using IGraphContentClient and await .GetAsContentAsync().

Findings.Message: Static 'SearchClient.Instance' usage detected. CMS 13 requires dependency-injected IGraphContentClient.
Findings.SuggestedFix: Inject IGraphContentClient via the constructor and remove the static SearchClient reference.

Findings.Message: Project references unsupported package 'EPiServer.Find.Cms'. Search & Navigation is not supported in CMS 13.
Findings.SuggestedFix: Remove the package and install 'Optimizely.Graph.Cms.Query' and 'Optimizely.Graph.AspNetCore'.

Findings.RuleTitle: Legacy Find and Hardcoded Graph Configuration
Findings.SuggestedFix: Replace with the Optimizely Graph configuration section (GatewayAddress, AppKey, Secret, SingleKey).

Findings.RuleTitle: Legacy Find and Hardcoded Graph Configuration
Findings.Message: Hardcoded Graph 'AppKey' value detected in configuration file.
Findings.SuggestedFix: Supply Graph credentials via environment variables or a secret store (e.g. DXP app settings) so keys can be rotated without a deploy, and rotate any key committed to source control.

Findings.RuleTitle: Legacy Find and Hardcoded Graph Configuration
Findings.Message: Hardcoded Graph 'SingleKey' value detected in configuration file.
Findings.SuggestedFix: Supply Graph credentials via environment variables or a secret store (e.g. DXP app settings) so keys can be rotated without a deploy, and rotate any key committed to source control.

Findings.Message: Access to 'ContentArea.FilteredItems' detected. In CMS 13 this property is marked [Obsolete(error: true)], so any use fails to compile. (unverified: syntax-only match; re-run with --semantic to confirm)
Findings.SuggestedFix: Use ContentArea.Items to get all items, render with HtmlHelpers or TagHelpers, or depend on IEnumerable<IContentAreaItemsRenderingFilter> to filter by the current user (Optimizely's own guidance on the obsolete member).

Findings.Message: Direct call to 'FilterAccess.QueryDistinctAccessEdit' detected. Distinct access query methods are deprecated in CMS 13.
Findings.SuggestedFix: Replace direct FilterAccess calls with IContentAccessEvaluator.HasAccess().

Findings.RuleTitle: Compiler Warnings As Errors Not Enabled
Findings.Message: <TreatWarningsAsErrors> is not set to true in this project file or in an imported Directory.Build.props. Obsolete CMS 12 APIs are easy to miss.
Findings.SuggestedFix: Enable <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors> before updating CMS packages to surface all deprecations early.

Findings.Message: Project targets 'net8.0', which does not include .NET 10 or later.
Findings.SuggestedFix: Plan the framework upgrade to .NET 10 as part of the CMS 13 upgrade (the Upgrade Assistant can help with the framework change).
